Watch a Demo.
Get a Chance to Win $20.

Discover what Eyefinity Encompass can do for your practice with our on-demand demos and you could win $20.
Watch Now

Meet Eyefinity Encompass

Our core four functionality keeps your practice connected!

Practice Management

Seamless patient care starts with your staff.

Features like Integrated Online Scheduling or VSP software integration for Bulk Eligibilities and Authorizations prepares your team in advance for a smoother patient experience. 
Request Demo

EHR

Incite faster and more efficient exam documentation.

The best eyecare software enables you to organize charts faster so you can focus on your patients. Reduce busywork and increase accuracy with optometry software you can trust.
Request Demo

Patient Engagement

See why modern tech matters to your patients.

Eyefinity provides software for Optometrists with unmatched convenience, like Eyefinity Digital Marketing Services, Eyefinity PatientNavigator™, and eyewear-ready notifications.
Request Demo

Analytics

Access insights to make data driven decisions. 

The best optometry software helps practices understand what’s needed to grow with Marketing-led data reports and reviews, Ring Analytics and AI, Sales Revenue in a single integrated solution. 
Request Demo

Harness the Power of One Platform

Eyefinity Encompass is the eye care software platform offering an easier way to workflow with functionality that meets all your needs.

"I love all the bells and whistles of the Eyefinity systems and how smooth and seamless they are to use. The cloud-based technology is amazing and saves so much time."

Shane Fontenot, O.D. of Advanced Family Eyecare

 
Request Demo

Our Biggest Offer of the Year, $0 to Start

Are you a PECAA Max member? The Eyefinity PECAA Max member makes it easier and affordable to switch to Eyefinity Encompass with savings on onboarding, subscription fees, training, and key add-on solutions.
Request Demo

Keeping up with Eyefinity Encompass

An elevated patient experience starts with modern technology. Stay up to date with the latest in Eyefinity Encompass!

Exam workflows built for how ODs actually work.

Save time documenting with EncompassScribe by Eyefinity, the newest AI-assisted documentation tool built into Eyefinity Encompass®.
View the Product

Switching Made Simple: $0 to Start

The Eyefinity® PECAA Max member offer makes it easy and affordable to switch to Eyefinity Encompass® with savings on onboarding, subscription fees, training, and key add-on solutions. 
Get a Demo

See More Success with Eyefinity Encompass

Join the growing number of practices that are bringing their vision to life with a VSP-integrated optometry EHR software that is designed to help you reach your goals.

Est. 2014

We've continued to innovate optometry EHR and bring you new features, deliver top-notch data security, and keep you HIPAA-compliant.

20+ Million Exams Annually

That's some serious efficiency! With automatic coding, you can focus on patients, not paperwork.

9,300+ Footprint

Trusted by more optometrists, nation-wide, we're the number-one choice of independent practices for advanced optometry EHR solutions.

End your day earlier by delivering efficient solutions that free you to accomplish more in less time.

"[Eyefinity Encompass] creates less stress and more profit with less hours of work."  
— Janelle R., Office Manager
Request Demo

Ditch the Digital Clutter

Uncomplicate your workflow with seamless integrations that streamline every layer of your eye care practice.

Eyefinity Encompass and the VSP Software Integration

Prep patient visits with Eyefinity’s optometry software and the VSP software integration by pulling insurance verifications up to seven days in advance, saving your staff time at every check-in.
Learn more

Safeguard What Matters Most with Eyefinity

Protect against a data breach with the first SOC 2 Type 2 certified, optometry software on the market—backed by over 150+ cybersecurity controls to maximize your data safety.
Learn more

Functionalities for All Your Eye Care Practice Needs

Whether you’re looking to ditch double data entry on exams or automate your staff's workflow, Eyefinity Encompass lets you explore the functionalities that best fit your eyecare software needs.  
Learn more
